name: Lake LA-4 Buccaneer / Renegade
summary: Four-seat amphibian flying boat with a pylon-mounted pusher engine high above the cabin and a T-tail; the retractable wheels live in the hull.

wings: Cantilever shoulder wing with no struts
engines: Single pusher engine on a pylon above the hull
fuselage: Boat hull with a step below the cabin
Retractable tricycle gear stowed in the hull
Cabin set below the engine pylon
tail: T-tail with the horizontal stabilizer atop the fin

tellTales: Amphibian boat hull with a high, pylon-mounted pusher engine
Cantilever wing with floats at the tips

confusedWith.howToTell: The Lake has a cantilever wing, a pylon engine and a T-tail; the Seabee has a lift strut each side and a conventional tail arrangement.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
